instance_id.title: OpenText NOM instance ID
instance_id.description: Stable identifier for this NOM installation (for example nom-prod). It becomes part of source object IDs; do not rename it later.

nnm_url.title: NNMi origin URL
nnm_url.description: NNMi HTTPS origin only (no path) when Network Automation is integrated with NNMi. Example: https://nnm.example.com:443. The plugin requests the token from {nnm_url}/idp/oauth2/token. Leave blank for standalone Network Automation.

token_url.title: OAuth token URL
token_url.description: Leave blank unless you must override the derived token endpoint. NNMi-integrated example: https://nnm.example.com:443/idp/oauth2/token. Standalone NA example: https://na.example.com/nom-na/idp/oauth2/token. When both nnm_url and token_url are set they must match.

l2_endpoints.title: NNMi L2 endpoints
l2_endpoints.description: Leave empty on the first import. Optional ServiceRadar endpoint MAC/IP values for NNMi attached-switch-port lookup (GET {nnm_url}/nnmi/api/disco/v1/attachedSwitchPort). Ignored when nnm_url is omitted. Never populated from Network Automation switch inventory.

api_url.title: Automation wrapper URL
api_url.description: Network Automation REST automation wrapper, not the NA web UI and not an NNMi URL. Default path is /nom/api/automation/v1/wrapper. Example: https://na.example.com/nom/api/automation/v1/wrapper. Must be https, include that path, and must not end with a slash.

insecure_skip_verify.title: Skip TLS verification
insecure_skip_verify.description: Disable TLS certificate verification for Network Automation and NNMi. Use only when those hosts present untrusted certificates on a network path you already trust. Off by default.
